title: Does anyone visit funeral homes and cemeteries in their Mall World? I'm always walking, never driving anywhere. I have one central cemetery, always visited at night, always walking never driving. I know where I'm going but never see the name on the stone.
content: When I visit in the daytime, it's always an indoor mausoleum but atypical because it's a huge wing of a building, brightly lit, floor to ceiling windows, and a corridor you can hear the heels of your shoes clanking on. There's memorial benches and I'm following someone, I don't know who to do paperwork. I enter my actual Mall World here sometime where the stores, escalators, food court, casino, restaurants, train stations are.
